It looks like the current approach only works for migrations where storage version migrations are triggered by the admission chain.

Here's the CRD case I was expecting to be supported:

- CRD created with version v1beta1 (serving and storage)
- CRs are written and stored as v1beta1
- CRD introduces v1 (for serving only), and a conversion webhook is added
- CRs are written to both versions, and are stored as v1beta1
- CRD storage version is changed from v1beta1 to v1
- CRs are written to both versions, but are now stored as v1  (storage contains both v1 and v1beta1 CRs)
- CRD is updated to no longer serve v1beta1 (storage STILL contains both v1 and v1beta1 CRs)

If the conversion webhook is removed the CRD is broken because it becomes unable to serve v1beta1 CRs in storage.

I added the test which does following:

```txt
TestStorageVersionMigrationWithCRD is an integration test that verifies storage version migration works with CRD.
This test asserts following scenarios:
1. CRD is created with version v1 (serving and storage)
2. Verify that CRs are written and stored as v1
3. Update CRD to introduce v2 (for serving only), and a conversion webhook is added
4. Verify that CRs are written to v2 but are stored as v1
5. CRD storage version is changed from v1 to v2
6. Verify that CRs are written to v2 version and also stored as v2
7. Perform Storage Version Migration to migrate all v1 CRs to v2
8. CRD is updated to no longer serve v1
9. Shutdown conversion webhook
10. Verify RV and Generations of CRs
```

I haven't read the code but I think you need:

6. Verify that CR written as either v1 or v2 version are stored as v2
6a. Verify that etcd contains both v1 and v2 encoded objects

And also:

11. Verify that resource can be listed via v2 (without webhook)
Thanks @enj. I have added 6/6a. 11 is included in the 10 as it does a get call to CR on v2 for RV check.

@enj @deads2k I have added all the request checks. The tests now validates following:

```txt
TestStorageVersionMigrationWithCRD is an integration test that verifies storage version migration works with CRD.

1. CRD is created with version v1 (serving and storage)
2. Verify that CRs are written and stored as v1
3. Update CRD to introduce v2 (for serving only), and a conversion webhook is added
4. Verify that CRs are written to v2 but are stored as v1
5. CRD storage version is changed from v1 to v2

8. CRD is updated to no longer serve v1
9. Shutdown conversion webhook
10. Verify RV and Generations of CRs
11. Verify the list of CRs at v2 works
```
